courses.note: Newest findable public site is Spring 2021 (pre-ChatGPT). The same host serves that page under later term URLs (2022spring to 2025fall), which are aliases, not later syllabi. CSCI 2200 ran in Fall 2025 per the registrar, but no public site was found. CSCI 2330 (systems) is also required; a Fall 2023 Foundations of Computer Systems site (https://tildesites.bowdoin.edu/~sbarker/teaching/courses/systems/23fall/) has a generative-AI citation rule but is not a frame course.
The major requires no software engineering course and no capstone; CSCI 2335 Software Engineering is an elective and honors/independent study does not count toward the requirements.
